meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezk.1.3;
father of: Ezekiel (H3168H)
§ Buzi = "my contempt"
father of Ezekiel (or ancestor)

elsewhere.note: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.
